# Vendored web assets

These files are served locally. Native packages omit PeerJS, which is used only
by the static hosted version.

| Dependency | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PeerJS | 1.5.4 | MIT |
| qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | MIT |
| mammoth | 1.8.0 | BSD-2-Clause |
| IBM Plex Sans/Mono, Onest, Inter, PT Sans, Merriweather, Montserrat, JetBrains Mono | WOFF2 subsets | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| Roboto Slab | WOFF2 subsets | Apache 2.0 |
| Noto Sans Arabic, Devanagari and SC | Regular WOFF2 subsets | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Font faces cover Latin/Cyrillic and the additional script-specific fallbacks.
`fonts.css` uses local URLs and unicode ranges so unused subsets are not loaded.
Source URLs and SHA-256 are recorded in `SOURCES.json`; license texts are in
`licenses/`. Preserve these when updating a dependency.

`keep-awake.mp4` and `keep-awake.webm` are generated by
[`script/make_wake_video.sh`](../../script/make_wake_video.sh): a 16×16 black frame
at 1 fps, 30 seconds, with a silent audio track. They are used only when native
screen protection or Wake Lock is unavailable.
